concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's methodology explicitly includes an 'Independence Check' — 'Ensure the validation target (experimental D) is derived from independent measurements (e.g., permeation experiments) distinct from the input descriptors... avoiding circular validation.' No FR or acceptance scenario in the spec addresses descriptor/target source separation or leakage prevention. This is also mandated by Constitution Principle VII (Independent Validation and Descriptor Provenance). Add an FR requiring documented separation of descriptor provenance from the validation target, and that k-NN imputation not use the target variable.

The idea's preprocessing specifies 'normalize all numerical features using StandardScaler'; the spec only covers unit harmonization of diffusion coefficients (US-1 SC-3) and omits feature scaling. Confirm this is intentional or add it to FR-001 to avoid silent narrowing of the stated preprocessing pipeline.
